style: Hand-painted stylised texture for a bright, high-fantasy voxel game. Painterly: soft brush shapes, chunky readable forms, detail gathered in clumps, never photographic and never noisy. One light from the top left: each shape has a highlight on its top-left edge and shade on its bottom-right edge. Shadows lean cool blue-purple, highlights lean warm; colours are rich and saturated. Seen flat and straight on, orthographic, no perspective, evenly lit across the whole frame, no vignette. The material fills the frame edge to edge as a seamless tileable texture. This image is one face of one block in the game, seen from a few steps away, so the forms are bold and readable, never busy. No border, no text, no logo, no objects other than the material. An original look, not copied from any existing game.

textures.stone: The material: cool blue-grey natural bedrock as found in a cliff or quarry face, never built. Jagged, angular, fractured rock: irregular broken faces of many different sizes and shapes, at all angles, separated by uneven branching dark fissures, with chipped edges, small pits and fine cracks. About three or four large rock faces across the image with smaller broken pieces between them. Absolutely no masonry: no bricks, no blocks, no rows, no courses, no rectangles, no straight lines, no mortar.
textures.turf_top: The material: a lush, rich green grass lawn seen from directly above. An even carpet of countless fine grass blades pointing every which way, gently clumped in soft irregular patches that merge into each other, with small darker gaps between blades and bright yellow-green tips catching the light here and there. Low contrast and uniform across the whole image: this covers whole fields, block after block, so nothing in it may stand out or repeat noticeably. No rosettes, no star shapes, no radial tufts, no round mounds, no moss, no bushes, no flowers, no bare soil.
textures.soil: The material: warm reddish-brown loose earth seen from directly above, like freshly turned garden soil. Three or four big soft mounds of crumbly earth with smaller crumbs on them, purple-brown shadow in the hollows between, a few small dark specks and two or three small grey-brown pebbles. Loose and crumbly: no flat slabs, no cobbles, no regular pattern.
textures.trunk_side: The material: rough natural tree bark on a living trunk, like old oak. Three or four broad irregular vertical ridges split by deep dark furrows that wander and branch as they run up and down the whole image, each ridge lit on its left side, warm brown with purple-brown shadow deep in the furrows, fibrous grain along the ridges. Organic and uneven: not planks, not boards, not cut wood.

copper_vein.prompt: Keep this stone texture exactly as it is, same rock, same light, same framing, and set copper ore into it: two or three big clusters of jewel-like warm orange copper nuggets with cut facets, bright gold rims on their top-left edges, a dark outline where they meet the rock, and a soft shadow below and to the right. The copper glows a little in its own colour. The result is still a seamless tileable texture.

textures.foliage: The material: a dense mass of tree leaves filling the frame, seen from the side, like the inside of a thick leafy crown. Many small leaves of slightly different sizes overlapping at random angles and depths: deep blue-green in the shadowed back, mid greens, and bright yellow-green leaves in front, each leaf lit on its top left. Irregular and natural, evenly spread across the whole image. No rosettes, no star shapes, no flowers, no radial clusters, no sky, no branches, no gaps.

turf_side.prompt: The first image is our soil, the second our grass seen from above. Paint the side of a block of turf: the soil from the first image fills the face, and a thick ragged fringe of the grass from the second image hangs over the top edge, covering about the top quarter, with tufts and blades hanging down unevenly and a soft shadow under the fringe. Same style, same scale, same colours as the two images. The grass fringe touches the top edge all the way across. Tileable left to right.

variants.prompt: This image is a texture of one material. Paint a new, different patch of exactly the same material: the same style, colours, light, scale and size of shapes, but different shapes in different places, as if from another spot on the same surface. Do not copy any shape from the image. A seamless tileable texture filling the frame edge to edge.
